name: Charles "Rick" Richards

items.why: The item says no foreign ties were documented, and I found no conduct by this candidate that bears on the foreign-ties criterion.

for_review: I ran 4 searches and read no full pages, only search-result excerpts. I found no controversy, finding, charge or foreign tie for this candidate. The owner-site search turned up only an unrelated alexjoneslive.com article on mosquito control in general, with nothing on Richards. He was on the Nov. 3, 2026 ballot and appears to have lost, with 30.41% of the vote according to Your Observer's results page. He runs Rick Richards Inc., an environmental and land-management consultancy, and has been a Myakka City fire commissioner. The fire district merged into East Manatee Fire Rescue in 2021, so his fire commissioner tenure dates and any county-contract work by his firm are unverified. Worth a check: Manatee County contracts and campaign finance records (the Manatee Supervisor of Elections filings at voterfocus.com) for his firm, and his ELMAC committee seat.
